Orientation check: C1/C2 are upper-left and the ESP antenna is upper-right.

TP1.location: Far-left edge above POWER J1, beside C1.
TP1.expected: Approximately the external 24 V input when powered.

TP2.location: Far-left edge below TP1, beside C1.
TP2.expected: Approximately 24 V after reverse-polarity protection when powered.

TP3.expected: Power-ground reference for RAW24, VM24, and motor-power measurements.

TP5.expected: Approximately 3.3 V when the board is powered.

TP6.location: Far-right edge beside the protected tach regulator.
TP6.expected: Approximately 12 V when the tach supply is healthy.

TP7.location: Bottom edge left of MOTOR J2.
TP7.expected: Approximately 3.3 V when the MCF analog regulator is alive.

TP8.location: Bottom edge immediately right of TP7.
TP8.expected: Approximately 1.5 V when the MCF digital regulator is alive.

TP9.location: Top edge immediately left of SERVICE J5.
TP9.expected: High, approximately 3.3 V, when the board rails are healthy.

TP10.expected: State-dependent 0 V or 3.3 V safety-clear OR signal; interpret within a named test state.

TP11.location: Top-edge safety-test row, second from left.
TP11.expected: State-dependent 0 V or 3.3 V permission-latch output.

TP12.location: Top-edge safety-test row, third from left.
TP12.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while drive is disabled; approximately 0 V only when hardware permits drive.

TP13.location: Top-edge safety-test row, fourth from left.
TP13.expected: A 0-to-3.3 V heartbeat waveform after firmware starts.

TP14.location: Top-edge safety-test row, fifth from left.
TP14.expected: High when the external watchdog is satisfied; low when it times out.

TP15.expected: High when healthy; low when either independent overspeed source trips.

TP16.location: Top-edge safety-test row, immediately left of TP9.

TP17.location: Lower-left area above the bottom edge, left of MOTOR J2.
TP17.expected: High when the MCF reports no aggregate fault; low during a fault.

TP18.location: Bottom edge immediately right of TP8.
TP18.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while idle, with I2C activity during MCF transactions.

TP19.location: Top-edge test row immediately right of TP31.
TP19.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while idle, with I2C clock activity during MCF transactions.

TP20.location: Top-edge test row immediately right of TP19.
TP20.expected: High while stopped; 0-to-3.3 V pulses while the MCF reports rotation.

TP21.expected: 0 V or 3.3 V depending on Hall state; one physical rotor edge per revolution in operation.

TP22.expected: Speed-dependent analog tach voltage; near its stopped baseline with no Hall edges.

TP23.location: Bottom edge to the right of HALL J3.
TP23.expected: Approximately 2.58 V from the precision reference divider.

TP24.expected: MCF current-sense output; interpret only within a named motor test state.

TP27.expected: Normally high; a deliberate low resets the external watchdog.

TP28.location: Lower-left watchdog group, directly below TP29.
TP28.expected: External-watchdog input waveform when heartbeat gating is active.

TP29.location: Lower-left watchdog group, directly above TP28.
TP29.expected: High when the external watchdog is enabled.

TP30.location: Top edge immediately right of SERVICE J5.
TP30.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while idle, with activity during TMP1075 transactions.

TP31.location: Top edge immediately right of TP30.
TP31.expected: Approximately 3.3 V while idle, with clock activity during TMP1075 transactions.

J1.name: POWER
J1.orientation: Component-side view: upper contact pin 1 RAW24, lower contact pin 2 PGND.
J1.warning: Use TP1/TP3 for probing when possible.

J2.name: MOTOR
J2.orientation: Component-side view, left-to-right: pin 3 U, pin 2 V, pin 1 W.
J2.warning: Never attach a grounded scope lead to a motor phase. Use a rated differential probe only.

J3.name: HALL
J3.orientation: Component-side view, left-to-right: pin 1 3V3, pin 2 HALL_TACH, pin 3 AGND.
J3.warning: Prefer TP21 for Hall probing and TP4 for AGND.

J5.name: SERVICE
J5.location: Top edge, above the ESP module.
J5.orientation: Component-side view, left-to-right: pin 1 AGND, pin 2 TX, pin 3 RX, pin 4 RTS_N, pin 5 DTR_N.
J5.warning: Adapter VCC is intentionally absent. Connect only the five documented signals.
